callPrompt: Choose a suit to call your partner.

hint.lead_low: Lead low to keep your strength
hint.discard_low: Cannot follow - discard a low card
hint.follow_win: Points are on the table - take the trick
hint.follow_duck: Cannot or need not win - duck

tutorial.pick: First comes the declaration. Choose Rufspiel (call an ace for a partner), Wenz (only Unters are trump) or Solo (your chosen suit plus Obers and Unters are trump) - or pass.
tutorial.call: After declaring Rufspiel you call a suit; whoever holds that ace becomes your hidden partner.
tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick. Follow the led suit; trumps decide the winner, and which cards are trump depends on the contract.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click a playable card to select it.
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button.
tutorial.info: Card points: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2. Of the 120 points, the declaring side wins by taking 61 or more. Chips move with the result.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
